content.short: Eat The Pie is an on-chain lottery on World Chain with transparent draws paid in WLD.
content.description: Eat The Pie runs a transparent on-chain lottery on World Chain: players buy tickets in WLD, each round's numbers and winners are published in an explorer, and unclaimed prizes roll over. It has sold tens of thousands of tickets and runs as a World App mini app.
content.meta: Eat The Pie is a transparent on-chain WLD lottery on World Chain, playable in World App.
content.pageTitle: Eat The Pie - Decentralized Games - Lancers Web3 Explorer
